question: Why must the sacred offering and the vow of non-duality never be disparaged?
premises: The sacred offering must not be reviled.
The non-dual vow must also not be reviled.
The instruction is given as a firm rule.
inference: One must not disparage either the sacred offering or the vow of non-duality.
plain_english: O fair one, one should not revile the sacred offering, nor indeed the vow of non-duality.
